outline:
本課程介紹系統分析的基本概念與方法，以及如何從一個系統的角度來看待和設計複雜的資訊系統，從而提高系統的效率和效益。內容包含：系統分析、系統設計、系統建置、系統運轉、系統評鑑等之實施方式及步驟。學生需要學習使用一些專業工具，如統一塑模語言、資料流圖、結構化程式設計。
This course introduces the basic concepts and methods of system analysis, as well as how to approach and design complex information systems from a systemic perspective, in order to improve system efficiency and effectiveness. The content includes implementation methods and steps such as system analysis, system design, system construction, system operation, and system evaluation. Students are required to learn to use some professional tools such as Unified Modeling Language (UML), data flow diagrams, and structured programming.
